name: BurrowAgent
summary: In-app debug agent for Burrow — full file access to your app's container from your Mac.
description:
BurrowAgent lets the Burrow macOS app delete, move, create, atomically
replace, and live-watch files inside your iOS app's data container on a
physical device — the Simulator-style debugging experience on real
hardware. Driven over a file-based mailbox with Darwin-notification
doorbells; command paths are validated and confined to the container;
only public API is used. The agent compiles to a no-op outside DEBUG
builds, so nothing ships to the App Store.
